sloka: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च भण्डीरैः निचुलैः तथा ।अशोकैः सप्त पर्णैः च केतकैः अतिमुक्तकैः ॥३-७५-२४॥
transliteration: mālatī kuṁda gulmaiḥ ca bhaṇḍīraiḥ niculaiḥ tathā ।aśokaiḥ sapta parṇaiḥ ca ketakaiḥ atimuktakaiḥ ॥3-75-24॥

translations.english: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: देखो लक्ष्मण ! जान पड़ता है कि, सनोरस वन के मरनों के खट. पर बैठा हुआ जलकुक्कुट, हर्षित हो, अपने शब्द से मुझ कामातुर को विकल कर देगा
